params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$r='C:\Users\Xxkan\local-ai-workspaces\mhw-mods';$b='fix/heaven-gate-concurrency-20260929'
git -C $r fetch origin --prune|Out-Null
$remote=@(git -C $r ls-remote --heads origin "refs/heads/$b")
if($remote.Count){git -C $r push origin --delete $b|Out-Host;if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'delete failed'}}
[pscustomobject]@{deleted=($remote.Count -gt 0);branch=$b;main=(git -C $r rev-parse origin/main).Trim()}|ConvertTo-Json -Compress
